Scope held at exactly five declared paths and 11 planned standalone-comment regions. Word count fell from 1,164 to 543 by the documented comment-token method. Every region was materially shorter. Filtered non-comment projections were byte-identical in all five files, including shell shebangs, executable code, Terraform data, systemd settings, inline comments, runtime strings, and directives.

Validation passed: corrected persisted preserve-infra-data ERE guard; exact five-path census; focused mirror-lock/systemd suite with 4 passed; path-scoped diff check; make lint; Terraform fmt check; ShellCheck; comment-hygiene; docs index; generated env-registry check through make lint; commit-message hook; and rebar verify-commit-ticket. The original DD used BRE grouping in Git's POSIX ERE input and returned exit 1 on an all-comment diff. The tracker owner corrected only that DD expression and confirmed the plan certificate remained current before commit.

Per the user's explicit documentation-only waiver, no local make verify was run. Gerrit Verified will provide the full-suite gate after push. This lane did not push, submit, close, alter acceptance wording, run completion verification, or author the independent reviewer receipt.
